eli: Quick FYI — planning a compact base-image rebuild + runtime syscall hardening tomorrow 04:00 UTC. Need a 30m ephemeral KMS decrypt binding for the `staging-signer` so oncall can verify signatures during the canary. Also want PI-redacted audit exports to SIEM and a documented emergency re-sign path.

marc: Threat model? Are we granting decryption broadly or just a scoped principal for verification?

eli: Scoped. Plan: create `sa:image-canary-unseal@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on only `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/staging-signer`, add the SA to `group:canary-svc-temp@redwood.ai` for 30m then revoke. No other keys.

aya: Logging: we need cosign verify events in SIEM but with emails redacted. Suggest pipeline: cosign -> jq pick fields -> hash principal -> forward. Required fields: actor_hash, key_resource, operation, image_digest, run_id, cosign_version.

sam: Agree. Example pipeline snippet for runbook:
```
RUN_ID=run-$(date +%s)
cosign verify --key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/staging-signer registry.redwood.ai/base:2026-04-01 --output json \
  | jq '{actor: (.verification[0].signer // "unknown"), key:.key, action:"verify", image:(.critical.image.digest), cosign:.cosignVersion}' \
  | jq '.actor = (.actor | @sha256)' \
  | logger -t image-sig-verify -p local0.info
```
That way SIEM only sees hashed actor.

triage: vuln scan on `base-slim-2026-04-01` shows: HIGH=0, MEDIUM=1 (openssl outdated -> patched in this build), LOW=4. Re-scan before canary.

marc: I'll author an ephemeral Terraform resource for the binding so there's VCS history and destroy plan. Sketch: `google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding` for the single key, member = `serviceAccount:sa:image-canary-unseal@...`. Scheduler will run `terraform destroy -target=...` after 30m. PR must include automatic destroy job.

aya: PR must also include a runbook update: approval step (pagerduty ack) + second sec approver, cosign verification snippet, and the jq redaction filter.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-02T04:00:00Z — 30m window, 3% traffic to canary slice. Notifying oncall and sec. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/base-slim-canary.

eli: Add a post-window assertion: run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/staging-signer` and write output to audit index. If binding still present, auto-open issue and page sec-oncall.

marc: I'll include that check in the scheduler job; the destroy job will return policy and post to `splunk:image-audit` with tag `run_id:$RUN_ID`.

auditor-bot: Forwarding confirmed: target `splunk:image-sig-verify` created. Retention 14 months, ACLs: sec-team + infra-logs read, devs redacted. Tagging events with `run_id:1809998887`.

sam: Emergency re-sign path: if signer key unavailable, we will fallback to a pre-approved ephemeral signing key stored in a separate keystore (rotated monthly). Runbook will include steps to re-sign images and a short verification checklist.

eli: Thanks. I'll open the PR, add the PD ack checkbox, and paste the cosign+jq snippet. Ping here when PR is up. :thumbsup:
